integrity: The analytical proof establishes every finite input dimension. Code is a finite corroboration, not an infinite certificate. A plausible later article could not be inspected beyond its abstract and first page; priority is not independently established.
scientific_limitations: The sharp amplification constant is only for qubit outputs, fixed computational bases, and the Hilbert–Schmidt off-diagonal norm. It does not render this quantity a general resource monotone; the ancilla-erasure lower-bound phenomenon was already known.
title: Sharp dimension-parity law for Hilbert–Schmidt coherence concentration
